recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, heavily textured surrealist painting depicting two figures seated within a cavernous space, flanking a central glowing amber chalice-like void. The scene features a high-contrast clash between vibrant magenta organic growths on the left and dark, rocky structures on the right, all centered around a circular pool of molten orange liquid in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two seated figures and the central light source
Chromatic tension between the hot magenta and the fiery amber/orange
Contrast between the fluid, vine-like organic forms and the jagged, rocky cave walls
Juxtaposition of the dark, shadowed figures against the intense backlighting
coreInvariants: Central vertical axis of glowing light
Circular pool of liquid at the bottom center
Two white snake-like forms framing the bottom edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two medium-scale figures are positioned symmetrically in the mid-ground, crouching on either side of the central axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing amber chalice shape in the center acts as the primary light source and anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central glow, moves down to the circular pool, follows the magenta vines upward on the left, and cycles back through the dark cavern on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the cave recesses provide negative space that emphasizes the central luminosity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep magenta and hot pink define the left side and foreground textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Fiery amber, orange, and yellow provide the central illumination and liquid glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal for the figures and rocky shadows; stark white for the snakes at the bottom.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pinks and oranges against very low-value, dark backgrounds creates a dramatic chiaroscuro effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical cavern scene with a heavy oil painting texture. In the center, a large glowing amber chalice-like light source. Flanking it are two dark, seated figures. The left side is overgrown with thick, vibrant magenta vines and moss. The right side is dark, jagged rock. In the foreground, a circular pool of glowing orange liquid is framed by two white snakes at the very bottom edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a custom-lettered, organic script that mimics the flow of the magenta vines, or a high-contrast serif placed in the dark upper corners.

verificationChecks: Is the central light source the brightest point?
Is the impasto texture visible across all surfaces?
Are the magenta and amber colors balanced symmetrically?
Are the two white snakes present at the bottom edge?

adjustableVariables: Level of detail in the central figures
Width of the central glowing chalice
mustRedesign: Any specific facial features of the figures to avoid likeness
Specific symbols or tattoos on the figures
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture looks like physical oil paint.
Verify the symmetry of the composition.
Check that the magenta and orange do not blend into a muddy brown.
Confirm the presence of the circular pool in the foreground.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine symmetrical surrealism with heavy impasto oil textures, using a primary palette of magenta and amber to create a high-contrast, cavernous ritualistic scene.
